# op_items (Data Source)

Lists items in a vault.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vault_id` (String) Vault ID.

### Optional

- `include_archived` (Boolean) Also list archived items. Defaults to active items only.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) Item overviews. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Item category.
- `id` (String) Item ID.
- `state` (String) `active` or `archived`.
- `tags` (List of String) Item tags.
- `title` (String) Item title.
- `vault_id` (String) Vault ID.
